messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error-rate detected for /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1. Rule: canary-5xx-threshold. See alert: https://incidents.redwood/INC-4592

maria (prod-eng): seeing ~12% 500s on the embeddings route from the last canary push. Canary started ~12m ago. Rolling back?

ashwin (oncall): on it. pulling canary logs now. @maria can you paste the deploy id?

maria (prod-eng): deploy id: deploy-2026-03-15-1202-eu. deploy-bot reported green on healthchecks but traffic ramp reached 40% 10m ago.

ashwin (oncall): thanks. running quick curl against the canary box -> many requests returning: 
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{"error":"kv-cache miss: shard-7"}
```

deploy-bot: Rollout event: deploy-2026-03-15-1202-eu -> progress 40% -> target 100%. Associated FF: feature/emb-cache-opt.

julia (sre): looks like a cache pop pattern on shard-7 causing backend exceptions. If cache warming not completed for this quantized variant then higher cpu/mem may coinfect. Do we have an immediate kill-switch for that feature flag?

maria (prod-eng): feature flag toggle is feature/emb-cache-opt. I pushed a kill to staged rollout but the flag service returned 202 and then 504 on subsequent reads. Not confident it propagated to router pools.

ashwin (oncall): can we stop the ramp in the rollout manager and route traffic back to stable? I can also manually move traffic in the router. Which is faster?

kevin (platform): router API is faster for immediate traffic steering. do `POST /router/traffic-shift` with body `{ "service":"embeddings","from":"deploy-2026-03-15-1202-eu","to":"stable-eu","pct":-40 }` — I'll open a short window for manual change.

maria (prod-eng): doing it now. paste log: 
```
> POST /router/traffic-shift {"service":"embeddings","pct_delta":-40}
200 OK -> new distribution: stable-eu 100%
```

incident-bot: Incident update: Traffic fully shifted back to stable-eu. Error rate falling. Status: mitigated. Ticket INC-4592 updated.

ashwin (oncall): confirming metrics — 5xx dropped from 12% -> 0.6% in last 3 minutes. CPU on the canary fleet still elevated but error logs quieting.

maria (prod-eng): rollback plan: revert deploy-2026-03-15-1202-eu from canary and freeze that variant. We need a follow-up to investigate cache warming behavior with quantized kernels. Julia, can you take postmortem lead?

julia (sre): will take. immediate actions: (1) open postmortem doc, (2) collect canary node heapdumps + proxy logs, (3) run a synthetic warmup workflow against the quantized model. Assigning owners.

sam (oncall-2): I'm taking next-hour handoff for oncall. any outstanding manual mitigation I should keep?

maria (prod-eng): no active mitigation; traffic is stable. please watch embedding errors for the next 30m and escalate if >1% sustained.

product-ops: noting customer impact: 6 customers on EU region reported latencies and 5xxs during window; outreach queued.

ashwin (oncall): added a quick guard in rollout manager to prevent >20% ramp without successful redis warming in next deploy. Created ticket: PLAT-1023.

kevin (platform): also adding a router-side safety: auto-complete rollback when canary 5xx > 5% within 10m. I'll PR the rule now.

incident-bot: Final update: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident severity reduced to Sev3. Postmortem owner: julia (sre). Follow-up: PLAT-1023, QA-warmup-steps.

sam (oncall-2): acknowledged. handoff accepted. I'll keep an eye and ping if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

maria (prod-eng): good catch everyone. we'll sync in postmortem. thanks for rapid shift. :heart:
summary: Canary deploy in eu-west-1 caused embeddings 5xx spike due to cache warming failure; router traffic shifted back to stable; postmortem and platform guards created.
